responsibility: Declares the API for computing edge-induced ranges in GIMPLE CFGs. It provides the gimple_outgoing_range helper class for querying ranges implied by conditional and switch edges, plus utility functions to identify outgoing range statements in a block and to build boolean edge ranges for gcond edges.
same_name_distinction: Declares the edge-range query interface centered on gimple_outgoing_range plus helpers such as gimple_outgoing_range_stmt_p and gcond_edge_range. Unlike gcc/gimple-range-edge.cc, it provides the API and class shape for edge-induced range queries, not the switch-range caching and computation code.
